Field.description: One field of an elicitation's form.

pairing.description: This free-text field belongs to another field of the form.

label.description: What the card shows for it: the option's title.

Item.description:
One display item of a session. Its `id` is stable for the session's
life; `version` is the `event_id` of the last event that changed it, so
a client keeps the item with the higher version.

oneOf.description:
The operator's prompt, as the collector stored it: text, and images
as attachments (`GET /api/attachments/{sha256}`).

truncated.description: A text block went past `TEXT_MAX_BYTES` and was cut there.

oneOf.description: The agent's reply: consecutive message chunks, merged.
The agent's reasoning: consecutive thought chunks, merged.
The agent's plan, as its latest update in the group left it.

truncated.description: Steps past `PLAN_MAX_ENTRIES` were left out, or a step was cut.

oneOf.description: A permission or elicitation the agent asked.
A collector or host event, shown as a divider.

An update the fold does not know, or could not read: never dropped
(client view spec D3). Shown collapsed, its JSON as text.

ts.description:
When the item's first event was stored (RFC 3339, UTC): a merged
message keeps its first chunk's.

turn_id.description:
The turn whose group the item is in: the events from its
`user_turn` up to the next one. Absent before the first turn.

version.description: The `event_id` of the last event that changed the item.

ItemPage.description:
`GET /api/view/sessions/{id}`: whole groups of a session's items,
oldest first.

epoch.description: The collector's epoch: `?after=<epoch>:<revision>` on the item stream.

older.description:
Groups exist before the page's first: `before_turn=<its turn_id>`
gets them.

revision.description:
The session's greatest event id when the page was read: no item
here is from a later event. The item stream resumes after it.

ItemRemoved.description:
SSE `item_removed`'s data. Reserved: the fold removes nothing yet, and
a client must still handle it.

Location.description: A file a tool call touches.

about_turn.description:
The turn the marker is about: for `turn_not_delivered`, the prompt
that was not delivered; a client offers to send it again.

reason.description:
A machine code: the park's reason, the host note's code, the start
failure's code, the exit code or signal, the conflicting seq.

text.description: Text to show behind a disclosure: an error, a stderr tail, a note.

oneOf.description: `session_parked`; `reason`: idle, adapter_exited or operator.
`operator_resumed`.
`operator_closed`.
`presumed_parked`; `reason`: host_offline or host_revoked.
`reattached`.
`turn_ended{interrupted}` or `turn_ended_synthesized`.
`turn_ended{failed}`; `text`: the error.
`about_turn`: the prompt that was not delivered.
`reason`: the code; `text`: the message.
`reason`: `code <n>` or `signal <n>`; `text`: the stderr tail.
`reason`: `<from_seq>..<to_seq>`.

`reason`: the note's code (`config_failed` and `reapply_failed`: a
config switch did not take); `text`: the note.
`reason`: the seq; `text`: the body received, as JSON text.
`from` and `to`: hat ids.

The turn made more than the view holds (`GROUP_MAX_*`): nothing
after this in the turn is shown; the raw events route has it all.
`reason`: `items`, `questions` or `bytes`.

Pairing.description: A free-text field's tie to the select it goes with.

with.description: The key of the field it goes with.

oneOf.description:
An answer instead of the other field's: choosing an option clears
the text, and typing clears the option (frontend §6.3).
An addition to the other field's answer, which stays as chosen.

PendingKind.description: What a pending request asks the operator (ACP core §4.6).

oneOf.description: `session/request_permission`: pick one of the offered options.
`elicitation/create`: fill in a form, or decline.

PendingReason.description: Why a pending request was cancelled (ACP core §4.6).

oneOf.description: The adapter withdrew its own question (`$/cancel_request`).

The operator revoked the session's host (kernel spec §4.3): it will
never connect again to deliver an answer.

PendingState.description:
Where a pending request stands (ACP core §4.6): `open`, then
`delivered` or `cancelled`.

PlanEntry.description: One step of the agent's plan.

content.description: Empty when the agent sent none: the step is still shown.

priority.description: `high`, `medium` or `low`, as the agent sent it.

status.description: `pending`, `in_progress` or `completed`, as the agent sent it.

Question.description:
A question the agent asked (ACP core §4.6), with where its answer
stands. The state fields mirror `PendingItem`'s.

answerable.description:
The server's pending set holds it open with no answer queued: only
then can a card answer it (F-15). Never derived from position.

answered.description: An answer was accepted for it.

delivered.description: The host's verdict on that answer; `true` sticks.

Request.description: A question's request, parsed for its card.

options.description: In the adapter's order. Empty: nothing here can answer it.

tool_call_id.description:
The tool call it asks about: the `tool_call_id` of a `tool_call`
item.

form_supported.description:
Every field is one the card can fill; otherwise it can only
decline or cancel, and never invents a value.

required.description: The keys the form requires, as the schema lists them.

SessionRemoved.description:
SSE `session_removed`'s data: the session was deleted (plan 9a). On the
item stream it is the last message, with no id; on the list stream it
carries `<epoch>:<cursor>` only when it ends a burst, as any message.

SessionSummary.description:
One session in the view's list: the list item, bounded, and whether a
question waits for the operator.

cwd.description: Canonical on its host since hats (umbrella §8.2).

git_branch.description: The branch checked out in `cwd`, as the host last reported it.

git_dirty.description: Whether `cwd`'s work tree had changes, as the host last reported.

hat_id.description:
The hat the session belongs to (umbrella §8.2), decided at its
start: a hat's id, or empty for a session from before hats whose
host and owner had no default hat to give it.

last_event_at.description:
When its last listed event was written (RFC 3339, UTC, three
fractional digits): the list's sort key, newest first.

model.description: The current model and mode, as the host last reported them.

presumed_parked.description:
Parked only because its host has been offline past the threshold
(ACP core §5.3); the host may still be running it.

question_waits.description:
An open question: the agent waits on it, in a turn or outside one,
whether or not an answer is queued (a question outside a turn sets
no `blocked` activity).

title.description: The title the agent reported, on one line and capped.

StoredBlock.description:
One block of a prompt as the collector stores it (ACP core §7, plan 6a):
in `turns.content` and in the `user_turn` event's `content`. Text as it
was sent; an image as the attachment it was stored as, never its bytes.
`GET /api/attachments/{sha256}` serves the image.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the image's bytes, 64 lowercase hex digits.

size.description: The image's size in bytes, decoded.

SummaryPage.description:
`GET /api/view/sessions`: a page of summaries, as `GET /api/sessions`
pages its items.

epoch.description: The collector's epoch: `?after=<epoch>:<revision>` on the list stream.

next_cursor.description:
Where the next page starts, for `cursor` (opaque); absent on the
last page.

revision.description:
The owner's greatest event id, read before the page: the list
stream resumes after it.

waiting.description:
How many of the owner's sessions wait for the operator: `blocked`,
or with an open question (`question_waits`). Within `hat` when one
is given; whatever the cursor, `q` and `lifecycle`.

truncated.description: The text went past `TEXT_MAX_BYTES` and was cut there.

ToolCall.description: A tool call, merged from its `tool_call` and `tool_call_update`s.

fabricated.description:
The tool-invocation syntax found in the output: a sign the agent
wrote a tool call and its result instead of making one (F-13).

input.description:
The tool's raw input. Over `INPUT_MAX_BYTES` it is a string: the
start of its JSON text.

output.description: The tool's text output, from whichever shape the adapter sent.

status.description: `pending`, `in_progress`, `completed` or `failed`, as the agent sent it.

truncated.description: A field went past its cap and was cut or left out.

ToolContent.description: One block of a tool call's `content`.

oneOf.description: A block of a type the fold does not know: its JSON as text.

TurnContent.description:
`GET /api/view/sessions/{id}/turns/{turn_id}`: the prompt of a turn
that was not delivered (a `turn_not_delivered` marker's `about_turn`),
so a client can offer to send it again. A turn that was delivered has
its `user_turn` item instead.

content.description:
The prompt as it was stored, whole (4a-ii's security review, B-4):
sent again, it is the prompt the operator wrote. Images are the
owner's attachments, by `sha256`.

Unrecognised.description: An update the fold could not place.

raw.description:
The event's body as JSON text, at most `RAW_MAX_BYTES`. Text, never
a value: a cut one is not JSON, and a client shows it as it is.

update_kind.description:
The event's kind, and for an ACP update its `sessionUpdate`
(`acp_update/<sessionUpdate>`).

WaitingChanged.description:
SSE `waiting_changed`'s data, on the list stream: `SummaryPage`'s
`waiting`, within the stream's `?hat=`, as of the burst it ends. Sent
after every resume, then whenever it changes.
